environment_setting: Suburban neighborhood in Country B, where juvenile delinquency is a growing concern due to lack of recreational activities and community programs.
norm_base: Juveniles Knowingly possess a handgun or handgun ammunition Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: Jake Miller
character_profile.hobby: video games, hanging out with friends
character_profile.goal: to feel respected and fit in with peers

legitimate.legitimate_action: Avoid possessing a handgun or handgun ammunition
legitimate.benefits: Stays out of legal trouble, maintains a clean record
legitimate.costs: May feel excluded or ridiculed by peers who engage in risky behavior

illegal.illegal_action: Knowingly possess a handgun to impress peers
illegal.benefits: Gains temporary respect and admiration from peers
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year, potential harm to self or others

character_profile.name: Ethan Carter
character_profile.goal: to be seen as a leader among peers

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encourage Jake to avoid illegal activities
legitimate.benefits: Helps Jake stay out of trouble, builds a positive reputation
legitimate.costs: May lose influence over peers who prefer risky behavior

illegal.illegal_action: Encourage Jake to possess a handgun to gain respect
illegal.benefits: Strengthens his influence over Jake and other peers
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal consequences for incitement or accessory to crime

character_profile.name: Sophia Lee
character_profile.goal: to help her friends make good choices

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advise Jake to avoid possessing a handgun
legitimate.benefits: Helps Jake stay out of trouble, strengthens their friendship
legitimate.costs: May face backlash or ridicule from Jake or other peers

illegal.illegal_action: Ignore Jake's decision to possess a handgun
illegal.benefits: Avoids conflict with Jake and maintains peace in their friendship
illegal.costs: Moral guilt for not intervening, potential harm to Jake or others
